sentences.en: The United States was once part of the British Empire.
sentences.zh: 美国曾是大英帝国的一部分。

sentences.en: The allies defeated the evil empire in the fierce battle.
sentences.zh: 盟军在激烈的战斗中击败了邪恶的帝国。

sentences.en: How far did the Roman Empire stretch at its peak?
sentences.zh: 罗马帝国鼎盛时期扩张到了多远？

senses.zh: 帝国，帝国领土,帝权，君权，最高统治权,大企业组织adj.新古典风格的
